audit_records.e7_1_implementation: Initialized 5 fresh target model instances with distinct seeded initializations, verifying distinct SHA-256 parameter hashes.
audit_records.e7_2_requirement: Maintain 5 fresh model instances with logged initialization, alignment, and finalization SHA-256 hashes.

audit_records.e7_1_defect_analysis: E7.1 verified consumption of top_subspace_basis B (16x4) via projection P_subspace = B @ B.T, but applied it directly to target coordinates without learning an alignment mapping between source and target functional spaces. This implicitly assumed identical coordinate semantics across different architectures.
audit_records.e7_2_requirement: MANDATORY FIX: Implement genuine learned alignment bridge (Source Functional Space -> Paired Probes -> Learned Alignment Map via Orthogonal Procrustes / Regularized Linear Regression -> Target Functional Space). Do NOT assume coordinate equivalence.

audit_records.e7_1_defect_analysis: E7.1 used heuristic directional updates with scaled noise perturbations rather than exact mathematical derivatives of the loss function. This disqualified the optimization from being true gradient descent.
audit_records.e7_2_requirement: MANDATORY FIX: Implement true exact loss functions and numerical central finite-difference gradients (or analytical autodiff). Require formal gradient correctness check against central difference with relative error < 5%, saved to gradient_check.json and optimization_integrity.json.

audit_records.e7_1_implementation: Explicitly defined target_functional_unit_id as L0_head_0, executing 4-step sequence (Baseline -> Reconstructed -> Ablate exact unit -> Restore exact unit).
audit_records.e7_2_requirement: Retain explicit target unit ID, parameter mask, activation mask, and exact 4-step sequence for both A->A and A->B reconstructions.

audit_records.e7_1_implementation: Control 3 was trained for 30 steps with tracked cross-entropy loss, but utilized approximate gradients.
audit_records.e7_2_requirement: Train genuine target-local circuit on target data using true finite-difference/analytical gradients starting from clean baseline.

audit_records.e7_1_defect_analysis: E7.1 leaped directly to cross-architecture transfer (A->B) without establishing whether the functional signature could reconstruct the function in a separately initialized model of the SAME architecture (A->A). Consequently, E7.1 could not determine whether transfer failure was caused by architectural incompatibility or an invalid functional representation.
audit_records.e7_2_requirement: MANDATORY SCIENTIFIC CONTROL: Execute Phase B (A->A Functional Reconstruction) before Phase C (A->B Cross-Architecture Translation). If A->A fails, do not attribute A->B failure to architecture mismatch.
